explication: labml_nn is a collection of annotated PyTorch implementations of neural networks and related algorithms, rather than one application with a single runtime. The principal workflow is to choose an implementation for a learning or generation task, provide task data or prompts, and use its model or algorithm to produce predictions, generated content, or learned strategies. The README documents broad capability areas; the tree supports their module locations, but sampled excerpts do not establish most cross-module call relationships.
